title: Round 3: trace every branch

checklist.step: Count ordered routes with both base cases
Record every call after its children finish

hints: Two inputs need no recursive call. One of them counts as a route and the other does not.
Sort the routes of length n by their last jump. The two groups cannot overlap, so their counts add.
Make both recursive calls, n - 1 first, and only then draw this call's frame with the sum.

questions.prompt: How many calls does the two-branch recurrence make for distance 4?

choices.why: This counts only the descending length-1 chain.
This is the number of routes, not the number of calls.
